description: Source code for the 'Context' class managing browser contexts, tabs, and related operations in Playwright's MCP (Managed Control Plane) module.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Manages browser contexts, tabs, request interception, and tracing within the MCP module.

classes.name: InputRecorder
classes.description: Handles recording user input actions within a browser context.

methods.name: disposeAll
methods.description: Disposes all existing Context instances.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns the list of current tabs.

methods.name: currentTab
methods.description: Returns the current active tab.

methods.name: currentTabOrDie
methods.description: Returns the current tab or throws if none is available.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates and returns a new tab.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a tab by index and makes it active.

methods.name: ensureTab
methods.description: Ensures there is an active tab, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes a specified tab and returns its URL.

methods.name: outputFile
methods.description: Saves output to a file with context and client info.

methods.name: _onPageCreated
methods.description: Handles new page creation, adding it as a tab.

methods.name: _onPageClosed
methods.description: Handles page closure, updating tab list.

methods.name: closeBrowserContext
methods.description: Closes the browser context.

methods.name: isRunningTool
methods.description: Checks if a tool is currently running.

methods.name: setRunningTool
methods.description: Sets the name of the currently running tool.

methods.name: _closeBrowserContextImpl
methods.description: Implementation for closing the browser context, including saving videos.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the context, aborting operations and closing browser context.

methods.name: _setupRequestInterception
methods.description: Configures network request interception based on allowed and blocked origins.

methods.name: ensureBrowserContext
methods.description: Ensures a browser context exists, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: _ensureBrowserContext
methods.description: Internal method to get or create a browser context promise.

methods.name: _setupBrowserContext
methods.description: Creates and configures a new browser context, including tracing and request interception.

methods.name: lookupSecret
methods.description: Retrieves secret value and code representation from config.
